findings.claim: Actual native SELECT shows current650 tables/a0v161/zero enabled bindings/zero other sessions and three existing bounded roles have credentials; original password transaction is not replayed and saved secret file remains private.
findings.evidence: resume-material-4.txt 原生 JSON 显示 schema a0v_161、tables 650、enabledBindings 0、otherSessions 0、三个 role 均 hasCredential=true；resume-material-2.txt passwordTransactionCompleted=true、credentialFileHashMatchesOriginalPrivateIntent=true；resume-material-1.txt 脚本 assert 包含 passwordTransactionCompleted、hbaNeverModified、credential 文件 SHA 与 credential-intent.json 一致、文件模式 0o600。

findings.claim: Native SHOW hba_file and actual file text identify the exact current HBA reject barrier; all three real current credential connections are currently denied by that barrier. Proposed single scoped rule preserves every other byte and original ownership/mode/loopback port, enabling the planned post-change SCRAM test.
findings.evidence: resume-material-4.txt rawNativeSelectResult.hba_file=/etc/qyh_pg_hba.conf；resume-material-5.txt actualActiveHbaText 为 local trust + 两 host SCRAM + 全 IPv4 reject + 全 IPv6 reject；proposedActiveHbaText 在 reject 前插入一条 host aos_meta_head 三角色 SCRAM；exactOneNewRule 精确匹配；otherBytesExactPreserved=true；ownership 501:20:644；resume-material-1.txt 脚本确认 c.read('SHOW hba_file;')==HBA、lines 中 reject 位置唯一、规则拼接与预期一致、端口 18446/127.0.0.1 保持。

findings.claim: The unexecuted continuation is bound to active parent authority/lease/source identity/frozen review/EXCL HBA intent and never resets credentials; code checks original3plane identities, wrongpassword rejection,650preservation and zero enabled bindings afterward. Host activation and eight pages remain outside this scoped fix.
findings.evidence: resume-material-1.txt 脚本顶层断言 project_revision==AOS-002001、lease.task_id=='qyh-full-system-restoration-20261011'、lease.owner 与 r.OWNER 一致且未过期、source Id/Image/Running/Mounts/Ports 与原合同一致；assert con['status']=='CONSUMED_MATERIAL_REVIEW' 且 execution_authorized==False，确认依赖冻结审阅结论；assert not (OUT/'hba-execute-intent.json').exists() 确认 HBA 未执行；noPasswordResend=true、hbaExecuteIntentAbsent=true（material-4）、passwordsMustNotBeRepeated=true（material-3）、rootIsContainerConfigMaintenanceOnlyNotDatabaseRoleGrant=true（material-3）；verification.json 预期字段包含 hostActivated=False、eightWorkbenchesAccepted=False、secretsPrinted=False、passwordTransactionReplayed=False。

result.next_safe_step: 材料已支撑前两项断言，第三项要求‘代码在 HBA 写入后检查三平面身份、错误密码拒绝、650 保持、零启用绑定且排除 host 激活与八页’——此检查属于 pending 的 continuation 执行产物，但本审阅阶段 resume-material-2 明确 hbaNeverModified=true、resume-material-4 明确 hbaExecuteIntentAbsent=true，material-6 亦声明‘Pre-execution HBA continuation, not final acceptance’。因此缺少执行后的 verification.json 真实结果与日志。建议：(1) 由 Owner 决定本次是否仅审阅到 HBA 意图与原子脚本正确性为止并签发 NEARLY_PASS 边界结论；或 (2) 由 Owner 授权执行 continuation 后再用新 baseline 重新提交最终 PASS 审阅。两者均需用户在‘接受 scoped HBA 修复就绪但未验收 Post-change SCRAM’与‘要求完整闭环后再审阅’之间作出选择。
